note: Twelve natural-language rules arranged into the RASE template over vocabulary.json. Arranged by the session model on 2026-10-08 as a worked example of the arrangement step (the production run uses the customer's model key with compile_prompt.md and the same validator). Thresholds are the vendor-reproduced numbers of the research note; verify against purchased texts before use.

rules.source_text: Guarding fences must be at least 1.8 m tall.

applicability.note: applies to every fence; perimeter membership not required by the prose

rules.source_text: The emergency stop button must be within 3 m of the robot work area.

applicability.note: 'robot work area' = restricted space, a declared input; today's hazard_zone is the robot's posed box

rules.source_text: A safety sensor must be present within 2 m of the cell opening.
rules.clause: docs/policies/workcell_v2.md p03 (illustrative; refused by the August compiler)

applicability.note: openings are derived from the occupancy layer; needs observed coverage to be trustworthy

rules.source_text: Movable equipment must be kept at least 0.6 m clear of any machine guarding fence.
The gap between the bottom of a perimeter guard and the floor shall not exceed 180 mm.

applicability.note: 'perimeter guard' = guard that is part of the hazard zone's perimeter

rules.source_text: Where a person can reach over a protective structure, the horizontal distance to the hazard zone shall be at least the value given in ISO 13857 Table 2 for the structure height and the hazard height.

applicability.note: high-risk table unless the risk assessment says low

requirement.formula: c >= Table2(a=hazard top, b=structure top, risk_level)

rules.source_text: The minimum distance of an electro-sensitive protective device from the hazard zone shall be S = K·T + C with K = 1600 mm/s and C = 8(d − 14) for detection capability d of 14 to 40 mm.

applicability.note: hazard zone edge = restricted space boundary; K=2000 branch when S <= 500 mm

rules.source_text: Minimum gaps to avoid crushing: body 500 mm, head 300 mm, leg 180 mm, foot 120 mm, arm 120 mm, hand 100 mm, finger 25 mm.

applicability.note: which body part can enter the gap decides the row; largest applicable gap wins

rules.source_text: Emergency stop devices shall be readily accessible at each operator control station.

applicability.note: 'readily accessible' needs a reach radius; operator stations are not a perception class

rules.source_text: The hazard zone shall be enclosed by perimeter guarding; openings are permitted only where an interlocked door or an electro-sensitive protective device covers them.

exception.note: an opening covered by an interlocked door or a light curtain (covers_opening) does not count

rules.source_text: The stopping performance of the machine shall be verified annually and the results recorded.
rules.unsupported_reason: a procedure and a record, not a geometric or semantic property of the photographed scene

rules.source_text: Workers inside the cell must wear safety helmets.
rules.unsupported_reason: people and PPE are outside the static-workcell scope of this pipeline; a video/people pipeline rule, not a workcell geometry rule
